The '''Dragoneye Reaper''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol. The original pistol was built from scavenged parts by the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dragoneye]]. The weapon's popularity grew along with Dragoneye's fame among the criminal underworld. Soon many bounty hunters used their own versions of this weapon.

One model developed by an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] company was the [[C-10 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|C-10 version]].

==Behind the scenes==
The C-10 "Dragoneye Reaper" pistol can be looted from killed [[Kerritamba Village|Kerritamba]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].
